[h2]Update: Ver.3.0.15.615[/h2]

[h3]Video Optimisation[/h3]
Graphic issues on some newer machines has been fixed. Work has been done to optimise gpu usage and reduce random slowdown on some machines  experiencing lag.

The issue with the game not showing in the taskbar has been resolved.

[h3]Performance Optimisation[/h3]
A lot has been done to increase performance on all machines and make the game much smoother and keep a consistent 60fps.

[h3]Music System Updated[/h3]
The old level music has been removed. Music is no longer theme dependant and will carry over from the menu to the puzzle environment. Music UI options coming very soon. There is a single music style right now but more music will also be acquirable in the Kiosk and 9 default music styles will be available outside the Kiosk and freely interchangeable in the coming days.

[list]
[*]Settings button: Hide zoom overlay.
[*]Fixed game not showing in taskbar when minimised.
[*]Game window can be manually resized in windowed mode.
[*]Cursor changes scale when pressed or idle.
[*]Added reference image change size sound.
[*]Changed game intro logo pieces pop in sound.
[*]Edited pack tagging (more to do).
[*]Removed redundant video options.
[/list]

notes.title: Pixel Puzzles Ultimate 2.0: UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/ccbc0033508c802169fb924739fadb5b5807a845.png[/img]
Please read the notes first and then message me in the forums before panicking  about anything moved or seemingly missing. There is still a huge list of to-dos, some small bugs and annoyances are still there on the list and will be got to soon, I need to release this now before finishing everything or it'll end up being another few months before it's out. 

[u]NOT EVERYTHING IS FINISHED[/u]

It's a work in progress!

The game should run a lot faster now ive done a ton of optimizations in the background.

I had to manually move puzzles in the game over to the new system, in doing so there were a bunch of puzzles with errors, I think I found most of them. Any remaining I'm sure you'll have pointed them all out to me within a few days, I'll patch them as they're discovered.

There's new cleaner layout in the menu, I've tried to make it as simple as possible, there was a lot to cram into a small space but i think there's  lot less madness on the main screen now and it should be easier for newer players to navigate too.

If I bullet point all the changes so far the list would go on forever so below is a few noteworthy things to point out. If you have any other questions not answered here then feel free to ask.

Any bugs or anything weird or broken then let me know. I'm 99% sure I have it stable and good to go, so here it is. 

Sorry it's taken me this long, I really hope you all like it, remember it's a work in progress. I think I might now treat myself to a day off before attacking the still mile long ToDo list..ːenlightenedoneː..,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/71236470c0bf84c54fe0caa82372a4a923807d6f.png[/img]
[h1]Notes:[/h1] 
[list]
[*] There is a completely new folder structure so patches and downloads will be a lot smaller and faster now.
[*] The figurals area is locked for now but will be sorted soon. They broke in the new system but are top of the list to fix. 
[*] You can change the menu background in the Kiosk. Any toolbar skins you already had will be available to you as backgrounds. More have also been added.
[*] Clicking catalogue will turn the vertical pack selection into a pack filter. The filter can also be opened by the button with the 3 lines on it above the vertical pack list. You can indeed filter owner/incomplete as was asked for by many.
[*] New shadows on puzzle pieces and a few new animations to pretty things up a little more.
[*] Custom hotkeys will return, but, for now check default keys in the How-To-Play screen.
[*] Language is set to English temporarily but other languages will return and more languages to come. Some places in the game may still display in the language chosen in the old version.
[*] Hints for gold trade cost reduced from 50 to 25.
[*] Your fav packs are under the star button, can now have 25 instead of 15.
[*] The Kiosk is now split into 2 parts, there is the Kiosk where you can get customisable stuff for the game and the Puz-Shop where you can trade gold for jigsaws.
[*] A tooltips popup is coming that will give more details on buttons and items in the puzzle building area.
[*] All past challenges can now be found in the Challenge Menu with the current challenge. The current challenges' save carries over if not complete within the month.
[*] The theme options once finished it will have full saving of all selections, for now it uses the old style.
[*] Puzzles can be reset and rebuilt using the cog button on the menu puzzle's button.
[*] A new audio system is in the works, for now all themes will play their default music whilst the audio system is being worked on in the background.
[*] Two new puzzle buttons, "start new random puzzle" and "continue random puzzle".
[*] New reference image can be double clicked to enlarge and dragged around the screen.
[*] New PP Ghost ːUltimateGhostː[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: PIXEL PUZZLES TRADITIONAL JIGSAWS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/88f6cdcc2a231ccf65561a177833d9f20cf3e90f.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058200/
[h1]PIXEL PUZZLE TRADITIONAL JIGSAWS[/h1]
Containing only traditional piece shapes, this iteration of the Pixel Puzzles franchise is for you puzzlers that prefer to solve a classical jigsaw ːgoldenpieceː

Pixel Puzzles Traditional will give you the same smooth puzzling experience with all the same rich features and customization options you have available in PP:Ultimate and have come to expect from a full fledged Pixel Puzzles title.

An alternative to the intricate and sometimes wild puzzle cuts of PP:Ultimate, Pixel Puzzles Traditional will scratch the itch for those wanting more nostalgic classical jigsaw puzzles to complete.

Whilst keeping within the bounds of a classic jigsaw style, every puzzle made will still be a one of a kind cut, continuing the tradition that has been a staple of the series since it's inception.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/ef527cfbb4cac5f3aadacdd61256b1358db7878c.png[/img]
[h1]FREE TO PLAY[/h1]
The game will be free for everyone to enjoy and additional packs will be available to purchase with a variety of different themes and pack sizes.

There will be 5 initial free puzzle packs in the game at launch with a total of 12 free puzzles, with more to be added periodically.

Flash Puzzles will also be freely available to all of you to take part in and enjoy (more below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/3ade1e3b00b45f34361d25db99281013ba7c7e8f.png[/img]
[h1]BETA WEEKEND[/h1]
The game releases this coming Monday on 18/Nov/2019.

Yes, this is indeed very short notice ːenlightenedoneː

The announcement and beta was planned to happen at the beginning of this month, but we needed extra time to smooth out a few things and sometimes things just jump in the way. We didn't want to announce too soon as we had no idea how far set back we would be, thankfully not too bad.

Regardless of a completely botched release schedule with this title, we'd still really love to give you guys a few early days to try it out and give us some feedback. Our constant interaction together here in the steam forums is what has helped shape this series into what it is today ːHintTokenː

Most everything is done, a few things will be added for release like buttons for leaderboards and re-shuffling of theme music and such, but everything else should be working correctly so please report any issues you come across [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1058200/discussions/0/2803982773087955727/]HERE[/url].

[i][u][b]When is the beta?[/b][/u][/i]

[b]NOW![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/832f23bca3e9e155edd2f615812044ec3a61972e.png[/img]
[h1]FLASH PUZZLES[/h1]
Flash puzzles will pop up from time to time, and you'll have X amount of time to complete them. we'll send out announcements at the time they go live. 

You can think of these as similar to PP:Ultimate's monthly challenges without the restraint of the monthly factor, allowing us to do more of them and for more events and holidays.

You will acquire a unique Flash Puzzle Badge for every one you complete. 

Flash Puzzles won't be tied to achievements and once they are gone they are [b]GONE![/b]

There will also be a special Leaderboard associated with the number of Flash Badges collected, for all of you competitive puzzlers.

Yes, of course there's a special beta Flash Puzzle on right now till Monday ːgoldenpuzzlepieceː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/0d02568fba4d6aae136d78ab62a43c29ac0cb916.png[/img]
[h1]BUT ...ULTIMATE?[/h1]
Again, I want to stress for all the people who love PP:Utimate, you're still getting new puzzle packs, free Kiosk updates, additional bonus puzzles, holiday special puzzles, nothing will change and you're still going to find a new challenge puzzle on the first of every month at some random time in the day ːUltimatePieceː

[u][b]Advent Calendar[/b][/u] .....on the 1st of DECEMBER, don't forget to mark it on your real calendars ːchristmashatː

A kiosk update is also planned for December, stay tuned...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23471385/6cbb2cf85d88889d3cbaa313eb489ebe5d590be2.png[/img]
[h1]LASTLY[/h1]
Since the Pixel Puzzles franchise as a whole has grown into it's own thing, we think it's time to slowly split Pixel Puzzles off from DL Softworks and into it's own company. Nothing has changed behind the scenes but going forward things will start to migrate to "The Digital Puzzle Company". 

[h1]Ask away.....[/h1]
Come join us for some [b]BETA[/b] puzzling.

ːgoldenbitː

notes.title: NEWSLETTER: July
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Xumwk8K.png[/IMG]

Welcome to the June 2017 issue of our monthly Pixel Puzzles newsletter, your gateway to the amazing world of digital jigsaw puzzles.

Now you can enjoy jigsaw puzzles with out all the mess, the damaged edges and the lost pieces. Introduce your kids to jigsaw puzzles in a format they can relate to or find a puzzle that challenges you; Pixel Puzzles brings jigsaw puzzling in to the 21st Century.

You can find the full selection of Pixel Puzzles [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=pixel+puzzles]here[/url].

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cN61Ptl.png[/IMG]

[h1]PIXEL PUZZLES MOSAICS[/h1]
Pixel Puzzles: Mosaics, has just launched. This is our latest puzzling challenge and targets those of you who love Mosaic puzzles.

So what is a Mosaics puzzles? Unlike traditional jigsaws with their varied shaped individual jigsaw pieces, Mosaic jigsaws have geometrically standard shapes that are randomly placed within a fixed space. These pieces need to be moved around the fixed space until a complete picture is revealed. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/QI1OH6T.png[/IMG]

[h1]PPU CHALLENGE PUZZLE 8: July 1st – August 1st[/h1]

Every month we run a Pixel Puzzles Ultimate Challenge. The June challenge started on 1st June and will run through till the end of the month. These challenges are free to participate in and enjoy, so give give them a try. The puzzles are larger and more complicated than our standard puzzles and should they be completed within the month, you will be awarded an Ultimate Puzzle Piece. One Ultimate Puzzle Piece can be used to purchase any item found in the Pixel Puzzles Ultimate Kiosk, regardless of its Gold Piece value.   

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ZqZuhHw.png[/IMG]

[h1]New Pixel Puzzles Ultimate Pack Releases[/h1] 
[list]
      [*]Variety Pack 1- July 7st
      [*]China - July 10st
      [*]Russia - July 18th
      [*]Desserts - July 25th[/list] 

[h1]Keep up to date[/h1] 
Keep up to date with all things Pixel Puzzles via our [url=https://www.facebook.com/PixelPuzzles]Facebook page[/url] and our [url=http://pixelpuzzles.co.uk/]website[/url]. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/jxxL76r.png[/IMG]

You can subscribe to the monthly Pixel Puzzles newsletter to get all the latest and important Pixel Puzzles news straight to your email inbox.

[b]Click the link below and enter your email to subscribe to the monthly newsletter.[/b]

[url=http://pixelpuzzles.co.uk/] CLICK HERE TO SUBSCRIBE [/url]

notes.title: UPDATE: Ver.1.7.0.195 - CHALLENGE PUZZLES
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/JMm517F.png[/IMG]

Version 1.7.0.195 is now live.

So, after the long wait... Ready for a challenge?

[h1]Basic Challenge Info:[/h1]
Challenges are finally here, they are FREE for all players to participate in and we wish you all the best of luck. Be warned, they are not meant to be easy.

This first Challenge will run till the 1st of January 2017. Each challenge will be active for a specific amount of time. The challenge's end date will be stated at the bottom of the access button. To access the current active challenge click the button in the bottom of the left sidebar in the main menu.

Once a challenge has been completed you will be added to an exclusive leaderboard for the winners of the current challenge and awarded an Ultimate Puzzle Piece. You'll use these to unlock special puzzles in the Uniques menu that will be available at the end of December as the first challenge comes to a close. Your quantity owned is represented in the menu's top toolbar next to your Gold Piece quantity and Hint Tokens.

Basic puzzle settings are preset on a per challenge basis and can not be changed and the puzzle can not be reset. Therefore the ui tabs "Basic Options" and "Reset Pieces" can not be used. 

When a challenge has expired a new challenge will replace it and the leaderboard for the previous challenge will lock and no longer accept new entries. You can view all past challenges and view their leaderboards in the stats menu under the Challenges column.

If you do not complete the Challenge Puzzle prior to the end date, you will not receive the Ultimate Puzzle Piece for that challenge. At the end of the challenge period a new challenge puzzle will begin, and the old puzzle will no longer be accessible.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/68ODULT.png[/IMG]

[h1]Challenge Theme:[/h1]
We have a new theme made especially for the challenge puzzles. 

To change any of the theme's options use the "Theme Options" ui tab from within the puzzle. You can turn parts of the background on or off and change colour schemes as normal.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/QKe6K2s.png[/IMG]

[b]GOOD LUCK!!![/b] 

Enjoy!!!

notes.title: OFFICIALLY RELEASED!!!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/R1KtLLf.png[/IMG]

Welcome everyone to the full release of Pixel Puzzles Ultimate. There are 4 FREE packs with a total of 13 puzzles. 

As a thank you to all for your feedback during beta we’ve released a FREE 1000 piece puzzle for you to enjoy. [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/501170] DLC link [/url] 

Due to changes in the save code for pieces clicked in place, all puzzle pieces will be reset when installing the new release build. This will not affect completed puzzles, packs, hints or gold pieces as these are tied to your steam user id.

Gold pieces will now be awarded differently depending on the size of the puzzle. 1 gold piece per 100 pieces in the puzzle. An 810 piece puzzle will award 8 gold pieces. 

The kiosk is not yet accessible but will be finished and available within the coming weeks, then you’ll be able to spend your hard earned gold on a variety of unlockables. More info to follow.

[h1]Notable changes since beta:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New theme called simple.
    [*]Simple now set as default theme for new players.
    [*]Stats tab now available in the menu top toolbar.
    [*]Player statistics capsules added to the STATS tab.
    [*]Challenge capsules added to the STATS tab.
    [*]Leaderboard capsules added to the STATS tab.
    [*]Replaced unreleased pack's coming soon banner.
    [*]Kiosk icon changed.
    [*]Post-its tab removed.
    [*]Unique's tab added to menu.
    [*]Delete Local Data button glow.
    [*]Tray buttons can now be clicked to swap trays.
    [*]Pieces dropped on tray buttons will slide off.
    [*]DLC button in the menu sidebar is now usable.
    [*]Gold reward increased to 1 per 100 pieces.
    [*]Reworked piece save code.
    [*]Beta banner removed.
    [*]Fixed used gold achievements not updating. 
    [*]Fixed used hints achievements not updating. 
    [*]Right sidebar added to main pack select menu.
    [*]Featured packs area added to right sidebar.
    [*]Latest pack release area added to right sidebar.
    [*]In puzzle UI button labeled menu renamed to hide (hides UI).
    [*]Fixed Pterosaur achievement bug.
    [*]Reduced pack sizes in pack select.
    [*]Fixed fps drop when rain starts in the glass theme.
    [*]Reduced fav bar width to accommodate new right sidebar.
    [*]Next / Prev track buttons added to in puzzle config tab.
    [*]Fixed arcade ship firing when turned off in theme options.
    [*]Pieces spawn less clustered in the tray.
[/list]
Plus a bunch of small fixes and a few optimizations to make the game run smoother.

Enjoy!!!
